ambient_events: A door slams somewhere down the hall, and a chain rattles into place.
The dead vending machine emits a single, hopeless click.
description: The third-floor landing, where the carpet runner gives out onto bare concrete worn pale to the doors. Four units, 2A through 2D, brass numbers hanging by single screws. The iron stair rail is sticky. A dead vending machine in the corner, glass spider-cracked, snacks fossilised. The bar murmurs up through the floor.

flags.intro_lore: Two flights up from Lowry's bar, the hotel starts telling the truth about itself: carpet gone, numbers hanging by one screw, a vending machine that died guarding snacks nobody will ever eat. Four doors, four locks, four small victories against everything on the other side of them.

name: Third Floor Landing
